content.short: MOOAR is an equitable NFT marketplace and launchpad that prioritizes creators.
content.description: MOOAR is an equitable NFT marketplace and launchpad that prioritizes creators and turns ideas into on-chain NFT projects in minutes. It offers a 0% service fee and a tiered membership for traders, with a default 2% royalty on all collections. The platform is designed to balance creator rights with practical opportunities, helping new projects come to life quickly while supporting ongoing ecosystem growth. It aligns with the broader community's vision and goals and contributes to the development of a thriving NFT landscape.
